title: Rent Stabilization Ordinance Rent Cap
requirement: Residential rent increases are limited to the lower of 3% per year, or 80% of the percent change in the Consumer Price Index over the most recent 12-month period, and no increase is permitted if the CPI is negative.
key_value: lower of 3% per year, or 80% of the percent change in the Consumer Price Index
coverage_conditions: residential buildings and mobile home spaces
exemptions: residential buildings constructed after February 1, 1995, or mobile home spaces offered for rent after January 1, 1990
quoted_span: Increase in residential rents are limited to the lower of 3% per year, or 80% of the percent change in the Consumer Price Index over the most recent 12-month period.

title: Just Cause Eviction Ordinance Protections
requirement: After 30 days, an owner shall not terminate a tenancy without just cause stated in a written notice, which includes at-fault and no-fault causes, and requires notice of violation with time to fix before terminating for cause, or 3 months of relocation assistance or waived rent for no-fault terminations.
exemptions: housing produced in the last 15 years; deed-restricted affordable housing; hotel and transient occupancy; hospital and care facilities; dormitories; and other shared living quarters
quoted_span: After 30 days, an owner shall not terminate a tenancy without just cause, which shall be stated in a written notice.
